text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can produce art, music, and writing that look or sound surprisingly human. For example, some programs create paintings in the style of famous artists, while others compose songs or write short stories in seconds. However, many people believe there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination, while AI simply learns patterns from data. While AI can support and inspire artists, it cannot truly feel or understand what it makes. Perhaps the best results come when humans and machines work together.
